description: This source file defines a singly linked list implementation in Kotlin, including methods for adding, removing, retrieving elements by index, and internal node management.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list with basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the data at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Unlinks a node from the list, adjusting pointers accordingly.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Finds the last node in the list.
